categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Boomy Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of special robots and intelligent equipment systems. Its main product lines include special robots, nuclear industry intelligent equipment systems, and non-nuclear specialized intelligent equipment systems, serving nuclear industry, national defense military, and nuclear technology application sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies such as radiation-resistant multi-joint robots, intelligent control, digital twin technology, and modular design for quick maintenance. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including project-based production, customized design, and integration of AI and embodied intelligence for robotics. Key technologies include power-through and lightweight robot structures, full gear coupling transmission, sensorless force feedback algorithms, and digital real-time monitoring and control of nuclear chemical processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily large state-owned enterprises in the nuclear industry and defense sectors, including subsidiaries of China National Nuclear Corporation and Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation. The company also serves nuclear medicine, chemical processing, and military logistics markets, with products applied in high-radiation, corrosive, and hazardous environments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and production bases in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, and subsidiaries in Tianjin and other regions. It serves domestic nuclear and military customers and is involved in international collaborations related to nuclear technology applications.
categories.supply_chain_position: Boomy operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of specialized robotic and intelligent equipment systems for nuclear and military applications. It also engages in upstream R&D and component development to support its product lines.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing AI-driven embodied intelligence robotics, expanding nuclear and military intelligent equipment solutions, and digital factory integration. R&D priorities include developing high-precision radiation-resistant robots, autonomous four-legged and humanoid robots, intelligent logistics systems, and nuclear medicine automation. It emphasizes collaboration with top universities and industry partners to accelerate innovation and application.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct and indirect sales of customized special robots and intelligent equipment systems. The company sells products directly to end users or through integrators and general contractors. It also earns income from technology services, project delivery, and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Boomy is positioned as a leading specialized intelligent equipment and robotics provider in China’s nuclear and defense sectors. It holds a competitive edge through proprietary core technologies, high-quality products, and strong government and industry partnerships. The company faces competition from other domestic and international robotics and intelligent equipment manufacturers but maintains a differentiated position due to its focus on high-radiation and military applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 275.7 million, representing a 7.94% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 37.6 million, up 8.4%. It has a solid asset base of about RMB 1.57 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for over 11% of revenue. The company shows steady growth and is expanding production capacity through multiple ongoing facility projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Boomy emphasizes delivering high-reliability, radiation-resistant, and intelligent robotic solutions tailored for extreme nuclear and military environments. Its products feature advanced force feedback without sensors, modular quick-replace components, and integrated digital control systems, offering superior safety, precision, and operational efficiency. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, quality management, and strategic industry collaborations provide customers with trusted, innovative, and comprehensive intelligent equipment solutions.
